standingLines.line: 📡 VILLAGE STANDING — the System has noticed Haven. A village that fights, feeds, builds, befriends and explores is a village worth watching. The lesser seat is priced on what you did, not on one dinner.

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

🌿 A person, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~4 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 50s, with a missing fingertip has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A soft green glow under the water — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Elijah says "And you're still standing." the man in his 30s says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
